title: quick-spec template variables
description: Values for templates/quick-spec.md.j2 and templates/quick-spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from quick-spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

acceptance_criterion_2.title: Acceptance criterion 2
acceptance_criterion_2.description: The acceptance criterion 2 used under 'Done When'.

acceptance_criterion_3.title: Acceptance criterion 3
acceptance_criterion_3.description: The acceptance criterion 3 used under 'Done When'.

approach.title: Approach
approach.description: Two or three sentences on the technical approach and the one decision that matters. Say what you rejected: the next person's first question is always "why not X".

done_when.title: Done when
done_when.description: The acceptance criterion, verifiable and singular. If saying when this is done takes three sentences, the feature is not scoped for a quick spec yet.

feature_name.description: The feature or task, named the way the branch will name it. This is a 15-minute spec - if naming it takes more than a minute, it is too big for this template and wants the full one.

out_of_scope.description: What you are deliberately not doing. In a 15-minute spec this is the field that does the work - without it the task list keeps growing for a week and the spec expires.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: What breaks today without this, and for whom. Concrete enough that someone could disagree - "users are confused" is a survey summary, not a problem statement.

requirement_one.title: Requirement one
requirement_one.description: The first thing the system must do, observable from outside it. If it names a class or a file, it is a task and belongs three sections further down.

task_4_optional.title: Task 4 optional
task_4_optional.description: The task 4 optional used under 'Tasks (3 min)'.
